title: A specified scalar presentation gives the same coefficient-sheaf cokernel
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $R=\Lambda(*)$, and let $U$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $\Lambda_U$ for the pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For an $R$-module $Q$ put $E_U(Q)=\Lambda_U\otimes_{R_U}Q_U$, using the constant module sheaf and the canonical scalar map $R_U\to\Lambda_U$ of [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Finite free modules and cokernels are taken in the module categories [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-finitely-presented-module]. Let $m,n\geq0$, let $A=(a_{ij})_{1\leq i\leq n,1\leq j\leq m}$ be a matrix over $R$, and let $q:R^n\to P$ exhibit $P$ as the cokernel of $A:R^m\to R^n$. Under the canonical identifications $E_U(R^r)\cong\Lambda_U^r$ the diagram $\Lambda_U^m\xrightarrow{A_U}\Lambda_U^n\xrightarrow{E_U(q)}E_U(P)$ is a cokernel diagram, where $A_U$ has entries the images of the very same $a_{ij}$ under $R\to\Gamma(U,\Lambda_U)$. In particular $E_U(P)\cong\operatorname{coker}(A_U)$ for this specified presentation.

proof.text: Use scalarFreeIso from [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model], the biproduct comparison for finiteConstantScalarExtension followed by the regular-module comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-regular-extension-comparison]. The biproduct comparison intertwines every coproduct injection. Naturality of the extension-restriction adjunction unit, evaluated on each injection, reduces the basis equation to the regular-module equation. For the latter, extendUnitHom followed by regularExtensionIso is the coefficient map, by extendUnitHom_extendHom; the mapMod regular comparison has identity underlying map. Finally the monoid-homomorphism unit equation identifies the image of 1 with 1. This works for every finite rank; at rank zero the assertion over basis indices is empty.

Apply the already proved scalarMatrix_map of [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model] to the specified entries A and precisely these scalarFreeIso comparisons. This is the required matrix equality with the original source-column/target-row convention.

The existing scalarExtension_preservesFiniteColimits instance of [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model] follows from finite-colimit preservation by mapMod and the extension-restriction adjunction of [def-sfb-modobj-extension], using [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits]. Its additive instance ensures that zero maps are preserved. Apply Mathlib CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit to the specified q and hq. Compose the transported matrix equality with the inverse free comparison and the image of q; functoriality and hAq show the composite is zero. Mathlib IsCokernel.ofIso transports the mapped colimit cofork along the two free comparisons and the identity on its point. Thus the precise quotient arrow in the statement is a cokernel, with no flatness hypothesis.

The colimit cofork just obtained and the chosen cokernel cofork of the scalarMatrix have a unique comparison isomorphism, given by Mathlib IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso. Its compatibility at WalkingParallelPair.one is exactly the asserted equality of quotient arrows.
